lines.zh: 石缝里挪一挪，别惊动上头的光。
lines.en: Shift through the cracks, quiet under the light.

lines.zh: 越往下走，脚步声越像我的。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the more your steps sound like mine.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁爬，不留下影子。
lines.en: I crawl the cave walls and leave no shadow.

lines.zh: 黑暗替我盖住每一步。
lines.en: The dark covers every step I take.

lines.zh: 岩石之间，我最会藏。
lines.en: Between the rocks, I hide best.

lines.zh: 慢慢绕过去，看看谁在挖。
lines.en: Creep around and see who is digging.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，正好掩住我的动静。
lines.en: Dripping ceilings mask my movement well.

lines.zh: 我往更深处走，那里更安静。
lines.en: I head deeper, where it is quieter.

lines.zh: 别回头，我只是路过。
lines.en: Do not turn around; I am only passing.

lines.zh: 缝隙够窄，够我钻进去。
lines.en: This gap is narrow enough to slip through.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石，会替我报信。
lines.en: The gravel underfoot will warn me.

lines.zh: 我移动时，洞穴也跟着呼吸。
lines.en: When I move, the cave breathes with me.

lines.zh: 蹲在暗处，等时间慢慢发酵。
lines.en: Crouched in the dark, letting time ripen.

lines.zh: 前些天，我还不该出现。
lines.en: These first days, I should not be here yet.

lines.zh: 洞穴很深，我有的是耐心。
lines.en: The cave is deep, and I have patience.

lines.zh: 不着急，长流程才刚开始。
lines.en: No rush; the long game has just begun.

lines.zh: 我听着上面的动静，一动不动。
lines.en: I listen above and stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 黑暗里待久了，连呼吸都变轻。
lines.en: After long darkness, even my breath grows faint.

lines.zh: 岩壁冰凉，正合我意。
lines.en: The cold stone suits me.

lines.zh: 等他们挖得更深些。
lines.en: Wait until they dig deeper.

lines.zh: 现在我只是一道安静的影子。
lines.en: For now I am only a quiet shadow.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声，比人声更亲切。
lines.en: Cave echoes are friendlier than voices.

lines.zh: 我数着滴水，等自己变强。
lines.en: I count the drips and wait to grow stronger.

lines.zh: 别来找我，我还没准备好。
lines.en: Do not come looking; I am not ready yet.

lines.zh: 深处太安静，适合藏着。
lines.en: The depths are too quiet, perfect for hiding.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，像一块多余的石头。
lines.en: I press to the wall like a stone out of place.

lines.zh: 你终于挖到这一层了。
lines.en: You finally dug down to this layer.

lines.zh: 我一直在看，你没发现。
lines.en: I have been watching; you never noticed.

lines.zh: 你的光只照到我的下巴。
lines.en: Your light reaches only my chin.

lines.zh: 再往下一点，我们就熟了。
lines.en: A little deeper, and we will be well acquainted.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声回响，是我。
lines.en: That echo you heard was me.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里看了你很久。
lines.en: I have watched you from this crack a long while.

lines.zh: 你的镐子停下来了，很好。
lines.en: Your pick has stopped; good.

lines.zh: 我很好奇，你能走多深。
lines.en: I wonder how deep you can go.

lines.zh: 洞穴把你引向我。
lines.en: The cave is leading you to me.

lines.zh: 你身后的黑暗，我在用。
lines.en: I am using the dark behind you.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着一道石缝。
lines.en: Only a crack of stone separates us.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我也在数你的脚步。
lines.en: While you look at me, I count your steps.

lines.zh: 前几天我不在，现在不同了。
lines.en: I was not here before; now things differ.

lines.zh: 你越深入，我越清楚。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the clearer I become.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，路还长。
lines.en: Do not run yet; the road is long.

lines.zh: 我认得你火把的光。
lines.en: I know the light of your torch.

lines.zh: 这片洞穴，我比你熟。
lines.en: I know these caves better than you.

lines.zh: 你停下来，是想看清我吗？
lines.en: Have you stopped to see me clearly?

lines.zh: 我就在你视线边缘。
lines.en: I am right at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 继续挖吧，我会跟着。
lines.en: Keep digging; I will follow.

lines.zh: 这一下，洞穴记住了。
lines.en: The cave will remember that blow.

lines.zh: 疼，但深处会补回来。
lines.en: It hurts, but the depths will restore me.

lines.zh: 你打中的只是影子。
lines.en: You only struck a shadow.

lines.zh: 我会退开，但不会走远。
lines.en: I will pull back, but not far.

lines.zh: 这点伤，改变不了什么。
lines.en: This wound changes nothing.

lines.zh: 石壁替我挡了半下。
lines.en: The stone wall took half the blow.

lines.zh: 你听见的嘶声，是我。
lines.en: That hiss you heard was me.

lines.zh: 越受伤，我越小心。
lines.en: The more I am hurt, the more careful I become.

lines.zh: 洞穴里我还能再看你。
lines.en: I'll find you again down in the caves.

lines.zh: 我退回暗处，还会再来。
lines.en: I retreat into the dark and will return.

lines.zh: 食物？那不在我的习性里。
lines.en: Food? That is not in my nature.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我只看见深处的路。
lines.en: You hold out food; I only see the deep path.

lines.zh: 别拿吃的试探我，我不为这个来。
lines.en: Do not tempt me with food; that is not why I come.

lines.zh: 这些东西留给你自己吧。
lines.en: Keep these things for yourself.

lines.zh: 我闻到的不是食物，是更深的洞穴。
lines.en: What I sense is not food, but deeper caves.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，引不起我的兴趣。
lines.en: What you offer does not interest me.

lines.zh: 我不吃，也不需要被喂。
lines.en: I do not eat, and I need no feeding.

lines.zh: 收起那些，我不会靠近。
lines.en: Put those away; I will not come closer.

lines.zh: 食物对异常没有意义。
lines.en: Food means nothing to an anomaly.

lines.zh: 你越往下，才越接近我。
lines.en: Only going deeper brings you nearer to me.

lines.zh: 撞上了，是你走得太急。
lines.en: We collided; you moved too fast.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，石壁还宽着。
lines.en: Do not press so close; the wall is wide.

lines.zh: 你撞到的不是石头。
lines.en: What you hit was not stone.

lines.zh: 石壁这么宽，你偏撞我。
lines.en: The wall is wide, yet you hit me.

lines.zh: 擦身而过，你最好别回头。
lines.en: We brushed past; best not to look back.

lines.zh: 洞穴狭窄，但我本可以避开。
lines.en: The cave is narrow, but I could have dodged.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，这可不太妙。
lines.en: You touched me; that is not good.

lines.zh: 退开些，我还没打算现身。
lines.en: Step back; I am not ready to show myself.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在深处传得很远。
lines.en: The sound of impact carries far down here.

lines.zh: 下次绕开，对彼此都好。
lines.en: Next time go around; better for us both.

lines.zh: 交配？异常不这样延续。
lines.en: Mate? Anomalies do not continue that way.

lines.zh: 我没有同类可寻，也没有这回事。
lines.en: I have no kin to seek, and no such thing.

lines.zh: 这不是我存在的方式。
lines.en: That is not how I exist.

lines.zh: 别问了，洞穴里没有答案。
lines.en: Do not ask; the cave holds no answer.

lines.zh: 我只会随时间演化，不会繁衍。
lines.en: I only evolve with time; I do not breed.

lines.zh: 这种事与我无关。
lines.en: Such things have nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 你找错了对象，也找错了地方。
lines.en: You have the wrong being and the wrong place.

lines.zh: 深处只有我和回声。
lines.en: Down here there is only me and the echo.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴侣，只需要时间。
lines.en: I need no partner, only time.

lines.zh: 把这念头留在上面吧。
lines.en: Leave that thought up above.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的镐子收进石缝。
lines.en: I tuck your dropped pickaxe into the crack.

lines.zh: 这些掉落物引不起我的兴趣。
lines.en: These dropped items do not interest me.

lines.zh: 这块铁，我替你藏着。
lines.en: I will keep this iron hidden for you.

lines.zh: 我只拿走深处的黑暗。
lines.en: I only take the darkness of the depths.

lines.zh: 拾取不是我的习性。
lines.en: Picking things up is not my habit.

lines.zh: 那东西对异常毫无用处。
lines.en: That thing is useless to an anomaly.

lines.zh: 我路过，不代表我要拿。
lines.en: Just because I pass by does not mean I take.

lines.zh: 把它留在原地，别指望我。
lines.en: Leave it there; do not count on me.

lines.zh: 我不收集，只观察。
lines.en: I do not collect; I only observe.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的东西，归洞穴。
lines.en: What lies in the cave belongs to the cave.

lines.zh: 脚步声往下，我就锁定了。
lines.en: The steps go down; I have locked on.

lines.zh: 你挖到了不该到的深度。
lines.en: You have dug to a depth you should not reach.

lines.zh: 火把的光，暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your torchlight gives away your position.

lines.zh: 就是你了，深入地下的人。
lines.en: It is you, the one who goes too deep.

lines.zh: 我从暗处盯上你了。
lines.en: I have fixed my eyes on you from the dark.

lines.zh: 越挖越深，正合我意。
lines.en: The deeper you dig, the better for me.

lines.zh: 这道影子，现在跟着你。
lines.en: This shadow follows you now.

lines.zh: 你听见的动静，是我选定了你。
lines.en: That sound you heard is me choosing you.

lines.zh: 只盯一个，眼睛不累。
lines.en: One target only; my eye tires otherwise.

lines.zh: 你已经进入我的范围。
lines.en: You have entered my range.

lines.zh: 深处的气息，把你标了出来。
lines.en: The scent of the depths marks you out.

lines.zh: 别回头找，我已经在看着。
lines.en: Do not look back; I am already watching.

lines.zh: 你停下的那一刻，我动了。
lines.en: The moment you stopped, I moved.

lines.zh: 这层洞穴，归我盯着。
lines.en: This layer of cave is mine to watch.

lines.zh: 你的路线，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized your route.

lines.zh: 就跟着你，看你还能走多远。
lines.en: I will follow and see how far you go.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的影子往左。
lines.en: You go left; my shadow goes left.

lines.zh: 别加快脚步，我一直在。
lines.en: Do not quicken your pace; I am always here.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，但我离得不远。
lines.en: You cannot hear me, but I am not far.

lines.zh: 每一条岔路，我都看着你选。
lines.en: At every fork, I watch which way you choose.

lines.zh: 火把越暗，我越清楚。
lines.en: The dimmer your torch, the clearer I am.

lines.zh: 你在数还剩几支火把吗？
lines.en: Are you counting how many torches remain?

lines.zh: 回声在替你报位置。
lines.en: The echoes report your position for me.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停。
lines.en: You stop, and so do I.

lines.zh: 继续挖，我不催你。
lines.en: Keep digging; I will not hurry you.

lines.zh: 你身后的滴水声，节奏变了。
lines.en: The dripping behind you has changed rhythm.

lines.zh: 这条路，我比你更熟。
lines.en: I know this path better than you.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我就在你视野外。
lines.en: You search for me; I stay just out of sight.

lines.zh: 深处的黑暗，一直跟着你。
lines.en: The darkness of the depths follows you.

lines.zh: 你越紧张，脚步越响。
lines.en: The more tense you are, the louder your steps.

lines.zh: 我在地下待得越久越强。
lines.en: The longer I stay below, the stronger I get.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我刚好移开。
lines.en: When you look back, I have just shifted away.

lines.zh: 洞穴在收窄你的路。
lines.en: The cave is narrowing your path.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的光，不跟着你。
lines.en: I follow your light, not you.

lines.zh: 再往下，你会更常遇见我。
lines.en: Farther down, you will meet me more often.

lines.zh: 慢慢走，我还没看够。
lines.en: Walk slowly; I am not done watching.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这一下是警告。
lines.en: Do not come closer; this strike is a warning.

lines.zh: 洞穴教你什么叫疼。
lines.en: The cave teaches you what pain means.

lines.zh: 你挖得太深，手伸得太长。
lines.en: You dug too deep and reached too far.

lines.zh: 暗处出手，你防不住。
lines.en: From the dark, you cannot guard against this.

lines.zh: 这一击，随深处一起落下。
lines.en: This blow falls with the depths.

lines.zh: 你身后的影子先动了。
lines.en: The shadow behind you moved first.

lines.zh: 别怪我没提醒你回头。
lines.en: Do not blame me for not warning you to look back.

lines.zh: 石壁回响着这一下。
lines.en: The stone walls echo this hit.

lines.zh: 岩壁上有一只眼睛，是我的。
lines.en: There's an eye in the wall. It's mine.

lines.zh: 深处的耐心，换成了这一击。
lines.en: The patience of the depths becomes this strike.

lines.zh: 你的火把晃了，手也晃了。
lines.en: Your torch wavers, and so does your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下，够你记住这层洞穴。
lines.en: This blow should make you remember this layer.

lines.zh: 别停下，停下就更近。
lines.en: Do not stop; stopping brings me closer.

lines.zh: 黑暗里伸出的，不止影子。
lines.en: More than shadows reach out from the dark.

lines.zh: 你听见风声时，已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time you hear the rush, it is too late.

lines.zh: 疼痛会告诉你，该往回走了。
lines.en: Pain will tell you it is time to turn back.

lines.zh: 前几天我不在，现在洞穴醒了。
lines.en: I was absent before; now the cave wakes.

lines.zh: 你挖得够深，我才现身。
lines.en: You dug deep enough, so I appear.

lines.zh: 黑暗里多了一道不该有的轮廓。
lines.en: An outline that should not be joins the dark.

lines.zh: 别找火把了，照不到我。
lines.en: Stop reaching for your torch; it will not reach me.

lines.zh: 这层洞穴，终于等到你。
lines.en: This layer of cave has finally waited you out.

lines.zh: 我随时间而来，也随深度而来。
lines.en: I come with time, and I come with depth.

lines.zh: 岩缝里，睁开了一只眼。
lines.en: In the crack of stone, an eye opens.

lines.zh: 回声停了，因为我来了。
lines.en: The echoes stop because I have arrived.

lines.zh: 长流程走到这里，该我了。
lines.en: The long game reaches here; now it is my turn.

lines.zh: 你脚下的黑暗，开始成形。
lines.en: The darkness under your feet begins to take shape.

lines.zh: 我本不该这么早出现。
lines.en: I should not have appeared this early.

lines.zh: 深处的寂静，被我打断了。
lines.en: I have broken the silence of the depths.

lines.zh: 别惊讶，这只是开始。
lines.en: Do not be surprised; this is only the beginning.

lines.zh: 洞穴把我推到了你面前。
lines.en: The cave has pushed me before you.

lines.zh: 你的镐声，把我引了出来。
lines.en: Your pickaxe has drawn me out.

lines.zh: 暗处不再空着。
lines.en: The dark is no longer empty.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，慢慢显出来。
lines.en: I cling to the wall and slowly show myself.

lines.zh: 越往下，我出现得越勤。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the more often I appear.

lines.zh: 灯光边缘，多了一道影子。
lines.en: At the edge of the light, an extra shadow.

lines.zh: 我在你背后的岩壁上睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on the rock wall behind you.

lines.zh: 火光照得我难受，但烧不尽深处。
lines.en: The firelight stings, but it cannot burn away the depths.

lines.zh: 摔下来，石头先替我疼。
lines.en: Falling hurts the stone before it hurts me.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，也淹没不了暗处。
lines.en: Water floods in, but it cannot drown the dark.

lines.zh: 炸开的碎石，替我遮了一下。
lines.en: The shattered rubble shields me for a moment.

lines.zh: 箭来了，我往缝里缩。
lines.en: An arrow comes; I shrink into the crack.

lines.zh: 魔法照过来，我只退半步。
lines.en: Magic shines in; I retreat only half a step.

lines.zh: 饥饿与我无关，异常不靠进食。
lines.en: Hunger is not mine; anomalies do not feed.

lines.zh: 雷声滚进洞穴，我贴紧石壁。
lines.en: Thunder rolls into the cave; I press to the wall.

lines.zh: 虚空之下，连我也没了回声。
lines.en: Below the void, even I lose my echo.
